title: Molten Moai
body:
"Look like this one still needs some time to cool down."

Description

You can find Molten Moai available for purchase at the Magma Cave Shop, priced at $7,980. Molten Moai stands as one among many distinctive variations of the Moai.

Appearance

Molten Moai has a texture reminiscent of Flameslate's Rock variant, complete with fiery effects emanating from its surface.
